rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
aura: Elephant/hippo bulk and unusual long-neck/small-head body (c03/c19) physically attack the canoe and raise heavy water spray (c04).
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of MOKELE-MBEMBE, the water-dwelling Congo River Basin cryptid, portrayed as a threatening creature from the documented legends [mokele-mbembe-c02].
ANATOMY: ONE long-necked creature with an ELEPHANT-LIKE bulky body, FOUR stout legs, a very LONG NECK, ONE SMALL REPTILIAN HEAD with TWO eyes and ONE long TAIL; smooth wet GREY-BROWN SKIN [mokele-mbembe-c03,mokele-mbembe-c19]. Elephant/hippopotamus body size, not mountain-sized [c03,c17]. No trunk, tusks, horns, antlers, wings, scales, dorsal spines or extra necks. Herbivorous, no huge predator teeth [c06].
MOMENT: the creature thrusts its small head and long neck out of a dark river-cut clay cave toward the low viewer, bulky shoulders pushing a violent physical surge of muddy water; the four-legged body and trailing tail follow behind the neck. One EMPTY WOODEN CANOE is shoved sideways by physical body/water contact, no occupants or injury. Canoe aggression comes from the historical report [mokele-mbembe-c04].
POWER: no magical power. Threat comes from documented canoe attack and massive elephant/hippo body acting physically; muddy water splashes and clay crumbles through contact [c03,c04].
SCALE & CAMERA: water-level extreme low frontal three-quarter view; long neck looms diagonally upward, small head close and eyes focused down at viewer, bulky torso fills lower frame; normal elephant-sized creature compared with empty canoe, all one coherent animal. Do not crop the head.
SETTING: river-cut clay cave at a sharp river bend, Congo River and swamp foliage [mokele-mbembe-c05,mokele-mbembe-c18].
LIGHT & WEATHER: one dominant fading gold shaft through riverbank foliage, deep walnut shadows, cold black water, natural river mist and spray, no luminous mist or magic. SURFACE: smooth wet graybrown hide with natural folds, mud, real water beads, soaked woody canoe, wet clay. MOOD: imposing confrontational wild cryptid, terrifying physical approach, not a cute dinosaur or ordinary hippo. HARD CONSTRAINTS: no people, victims, gore, text, writing, logo, frame, border, watermark, signature, borrowed movie/game/anime/comic designs; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no supernatural aura, neon, runes, beam or new power.

visual_requirements.description: Elephant-like four-leg body, long neck, one small head, one tail and smooth grey-brown skin; elephant/hippo size.
Physical approach/attack on an empty canoe causes river spray, without victims or magic.
Congo River swamp and eroded river-cut clay cave/bend.

depicted_variant: Grey-brown long-necked elephant-bodied river cryptid physically pressing an empty canoe at a Congo swamp bend.
